Call for Nominations  for Student Exchange Program at HCMUT in the Second Semester, Academic Year 2026/2027
HCMUT is delighted to announce that we are now accepting nominations for the student exchange program in the second semester, academic year 2026/2027 at Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT).
HCMUT is delighted to announce that we are now accepting nominations for the upcoming student exchange program at Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT).
We warmly welcome students from our partner universities to join us and experience Vietnam’s vibrant culture while engaging in HCMUT’s dynamic academic environment. HCMUT currently offers more than 30 programs fully taught in English, providing international students with a wide range of courses to choose from.
For further information about our international academic programs, please visit:
https://hcmut.edu.vn/en/study/program?lang=en&tab=1
Key Benefits for Exchange Students
Tuition Fee Waiver:
Exchange students from HCMUT partner universities are eligible for a full tuition fee waiver during their exchange period at HCMUT.
Supporting Services:
HCMUT provides support with visa applications, dormitory registration, orientation, academic advising, cultural activities, and other practical matters throughout the exchange period.
Academic Calendar – Second Semester, Academic Year 2026/2027
Orientation:
08 January 2027
Courses and Exams:
11 January – 07 June 2027
General Requirements
English Language Proficiency:
CEFR B2, IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79, TOEIC (Listening & Reading: 730; Speaking & Writing: 280), or an equivalent level of English proficiency.
Cumulative GPA:
At least 2.5/4.0 at the home institution.
Nomination:
Students must be officially nominated by their home university in the nomination letter.
Application Procedures and Deadlines
1. Nomination
The home university nominates eligible students to the External Affairs Office at
inter@hcmut.edu.vn
.
2. Online Application
After nomination, students are required to submit their application documents online via the following link:
https://ioffice.hcmut.edu.vn/url/s/sUXYs7v
Application form and nomination letter template can be downloaded at:
https://ioffice.hcmut.edu.vn/url/s/vdT5yxx
3. Application Deadlines
Nomination Deadline:
30 September 2026
Application Deadline:
15 October 2026
Fact Sheet and Further Information
Please visit the following link to access the
HCMUT Fact Sheet for the Academic Year 2026/2027
for your reference:
https://ioffice.hcmut.edu.vn/url/s/4ahF9K4
Contact
For further information or inquiries, please contact:
External Affairs Office
Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT)
Email:
inter@hcmut.edu.vn
